rows.07:17e78:
When I opened the door, a stifling smell hit my nose.
Something rank, and sweet...
What is this?
Without thinking, I glanced down at the floor.{p}
rows.07:180c0:
With a start I turned around, and there were words scrawled in blood.
Perfect for a blabbermouth☆
...This is insane.
Nausea welled up in me.
But I swallowed hard and held it down.{p}
rows.07:18180:
Now's not the time for that.
I don't have time to spare.
Convince yourself that what's lying there is just a thing.{p}I told myself that.
rows.07:189cc:
"Gyaaah☆"
The glass shard sliced off Hosoda's left ear.
"It hurts! It hurts! My ear!"
Hosoda howled, clutching his ear and trying to stop the bleeding.{p}What should I do?
rows.07:18cf4:
There were lots of medicines I'd never even seen before.
Couldn't one of these do the same job as the antidote?
...But wait.
For all I knew, a side effect could make the poison even stronger.{p}I'd better not, after all.
rows.07:18ec4:
Sending the bed flying, Hosoda burst out from behind it.
Oh no.
I should have checked the bed!
But it was too late now.{p}
rows.07:19120:
"Gyaaah!"
The screwdriver stabbed into Hosoda's eye.
Oh no.
I rushed over, but Hosoda paid me no mind, rolling around and screaming.
I felt a little sorry for him, but my life was on the line too.
I grabbed Hosoda by the shoulder.
"Where's the ampoule? Answer me."
"Uh... uhh..."
Hosoda didn't answer.
Maybe he couldn't.{p}
rows.07:199e8:
"Awfully sorry about that."
I apologized.
Hosoda looked up at me with teary eyes.
"I don't want to do this, you know. But I've got no choice if I want to live. You understand, don't you?"
"Uh..."
Hosoda nodded, again and again.
It was as if he thought he'd be dead the moment I got in a bad mood.{p}Now, what should I do?
rows.07:1a374:
Should I just let him go?
But he tried to kill me.
If I let him go, wouldn't I just be making another enemy for myself?
...No, it's fine.
I'll let him go.
This kind of thing just isn't like me.
Hosoda is my senior, after all.
I'm only a first-year. It pains me to keep doing this to him.
"...Go."{p}
rows.07:1b3c0: I tried the third classroom from the left.{p}
rows.07:1b534: I tried the fourth classroom from the left.{p}
rows.07:1b6a8: I tried the fifth classroom from the left.{p}
rows.07:1b770: I tried the sixth classroom from the left.{p}
rows.07:1b8e4: I tried the classroom on the far right.{p}
rows.07:1ba54: I decided to check the nearest 'number two' toilet.{p}
rows.07:1bff0:
The hallway floor looked like it could give way any second.
But I couldn't let that stop me.
The old school building, too, had seven classrooms on each floor.{p}Which classroom should I go to?
